title: Qualia are a by-product of what evolution selects, like the weight of a polar bear's coat

statements.text: Against the objection from evolution, Jackson answers that what evolves for its usefulness is the brain state associated with pain, and the sensation is a by-product. Evolution is full of useless or harmful by-products: polar bears evolved thick coats for warmth, which have the side effect of being heavy to carry.

sources.quote: Jackson (1982) replies to this objection by saying that it is the brain state associated with pain that evolves for this reason: the sensation is a by-product.
polar bears have evolved thick coats to keep them warm, even though this has the damaging side effect that they are heavy to carry
